note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions and PowerPyx's guide (checked 2026-11-20). Nothing in Step 2 or 3 can be missed: once the story is done, free-roam stays open and every checklist item is still reachable.

details: Play the 5 chapters (60-80 hours). There are no mission gold medals, so play however you like.
Do the Chapter 1 meditation the one time it is offered (see Missables) — it is the only thing in the game that can lock you out.
Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter; with no mission replay, saves are your only safety net.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals are needed later.
Do optional missions as they appear; quest givers who vanish come back later, and there are far more than the 100 optional missions the checklist wants.
stages.title: Story + side missions, scan as you go

details: After the story, the checklist unlocks at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts.
It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests are not required and collectibles are mostly partial.
The only things that need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
You need any 70 of 80 challenges, so skip the hardest 10. Each meditation spot counts +2 if you do it with both characters.
By the end of this stage most trophies will have popped on their own.
stages.title: 100% Completion Checklist + 70 of 80 challenges

details: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so finish your 8 qualifying strands now (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more).
Sweep up the miscellaneous trophies: UFO easter egg, bowling alley valuables, the blue Banshee showroom smash, the 10-pedestrian bike kicks.
Check the trophy list counters (500 profile actions, 250 stunts, 50 challenges) and farm only what is left.
The platinum pops the moment the last trophy does — no extra step.
